name: services/facperms/has_facperm
description: Check if access token issuer has selected facperm
brief_description: Check if access token issuer has selected facperm

arguments.name: fpclass_id
arguments.description: ID of the faculty permission class.

arguments.name: faculty_id
arguments.description: ID of a faculty. If not selected, true will be returned if userhas persmission in some faculty

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns: True if user has permission, false in the other case
